<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(f):
    d = {}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b = n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
        d[n['hash'][:8]] = (n['color'], min(rows), min(cols), max(rows), max(cols), n['pixels'])
    return d
def barlen(f):
    line = f.ascii.split('\n')[63]
    return (line.count('c'), line.count('B'))
print('bar before', barlen(current_frame))
before = snap(current_frame)
action(['UP'])
after = snap(current_frame)
print('after UP, bar', barlen(current_frame), 'step', current_frame.step)
for h in after:
    if h not in before: print('NEW', h, after[h])
for h in before:
    if h not in after: print('GONE', h, before[h])
    elif before[h] != after[h]: print('MOVED', h, before[h], '->', after[h])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
